articles.title_en: Kiev carries out terrorist strike on Belgorod residential areas overnight — ministry
articles.lead_en: The strike killed and wounded civilians and damaged apartment buildings, private homes, and vehicles, the Russian Defense Ministry noted

articles.title_en: Russian guard and inmate killed aboard train carrying prisoners. Reports conflict over alleged riot.
articles.lead_en: A prisoner being transferred attacked his guards aboard a Vladikavkaz–Adler train in Kabardino-Balkaria, RBC, Interfax, and TASS reported, citing law enforcement sources.

articles.title_en: Russian supermarket workers say they were fired over a viral reel about post-election grocery price hikes
articles.lead_en: Sochi bloggers Svetlana Izhilenko and Alisa Kunyashova said they were fired from a local Pyaterochka grocery store after posting a video about rising grocery prices the day after the elections.
